method: Paired bounded late-stage fixtures with actual World shots, collisions and spawning.

config.startingGrantBudget: stage + floor((stage - 1)/5), including the opening choice; no gambler bonus assumed
config.decision: 60 directions; count distinct targets along direct path plus one wall reflection
config.stop: first stage clear, failure, any non-battle phase, or the per-case time limit

limitations: Fixed acquired builds and stage snapshots, not natural random reward histories or complete player runs.
Instant full pulls on a fixed cadence omit human aim time, bullet-time use, adaptation, mobile latency and rendering.
Paired seeds do not keep encounters identical after mechanics alter RNG consumption, births or kills.
Bounded cases can end at the time limit; outcomes do not establish a human survival-stage target or prove optimal balance.
Source hashes must match for this report to describe the current implementation.
